comment: files.c read_wizkit() with WIZKIT=.nethackrc in debug mode: access() fails in the playground, so C raw_printf()s "Access to .nethackrc denied (2)." and opens $HOME/.nethackrc, the config file the recorder wrote from this nethackrc. parse_conf_file() hands both statements to proc_wizkit_line(); readobjnam() rejects each, config_error_add() records "Bad wizkit item", and pline.c vpline() discards those messages and config_error_done()'s summary because program_state.wizkit_wishing is set. Its wait_synch() does not wait, since the earlier wait_synch() cleared rawprint, so the game starts with the role's inventory alone. Seed, date, Valkyrie and name chosen independently.
